purpose: grade-1 reachable-accuracy bounds and size-matched nulls for the D4 519-noun inventory of record, under the committed single-angle FA map, as PRE-WORK for doc 63 / exp76
status: PRE-WORK INSTRUMENT, doc 54's status-block instrument exception (cited downstream as doc 54 SS0). This is a bound calculator, not an experiment. No exp76 experiment code exists.

provenance.inventory_gate: doc 59 SS8.2 sample-audit protocol, closed 2026-08-28: user approval (verbatim: "confirm the nouns, approved from my side") + Opus lexical double-check over all 600 (d4_model_check.json, reviewery) with its 81 vetoes APPLIED
provenance.inventory_caveat: model dominance judgments are informed estimates, not corpus measurements; any experiment registration naming memberships still states its own provenance
provenance.calls_not_copies: the search, the sign-flip invariant, the constraint rows and the null discipline are instrument_sb_bounds's, imported and called

features.formula: FA: phi = atan2(p2, p1); u = (1, cos phi, sin phi). d = 3. The EXISTING single-angle map (exp42 intro_convention, angle = atan2(y, x)); scaling-free.
features.pca_fit_on: union of the 519 confirmed and the committed 44
features.normalisation: p_k(r) = PC_k(r) / max_{r' in the 519} |PC_k(r')|; REGISTERED as a population change from load_raw's max over the 24 HUMANS (doc 47 SS18.5)
features.leakage_condition: valid for splits over unseen PAIRINGS only; if any arm splits over unseen NOUNS, doc 51 SS4 binds and this featurizer is invalid for that arm

population.statement: EVERY bound here is the n = 2 SB decision sign(u_a^T C u_p) over the 519-noun inventory. capacity_check.py's scope statement binds: this instrument is NOT a bound 'on tasks with more than two referents'. It is a statement about the INVENTORY, and it is NOT a grade-1 bound for any exp76 arm at n > 2.

exactness.why: exact_maxfs_r3 is O(n_rows^3); n_rows here is 2060-28728 against <= 190 at the committed 24-noun scale. Measured: it did not complete in 120 s at the smallest 519-scale contrast tried.
exactness.consequence: every 519-scale value is a CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND. A measured accuracy above it is not a violation.

membership_provenance_table.why_this_table_exists: doc 47 SS13.4 makes category membership a DESIGN INPUT with a stated provenance; doc 54 SS5.1 records what happens when it is not written down. No 'membership provenance table' existed in the private repo before this file; this is its first instance.

faail_surface.provenance_class: SURFACE REGEX over a CAMeL-derived lemma
faail_surface.producer_own_words: its own comment reads 'Surface wazn tags. DESCRIPTIVE metadata attached to the admitting analysis's lemma -- they are not admission rules and carry no semantic claim.'
faail_surface.confirmation: PROGRAMMATIC. The user's 2026-08-28 approval (doc 59 SS8.4) confirmed HUMAN-DENOTING-NESS over the 600 candidates; it did not confirm any wazn tag.
faail_surface.known_defect: rule ORDER: the m-initial and yaa-final tests fire before the faaCil test, so m-initial and defective-root participles are mis-tagged. The inventory carries an audit note recording one such case in its own data (المصري: 'Wazn tag mu_participle is an error').

faail_camel.produced_by: CAMeL Tools MorphologyDB.builtin_db(), the admitting analysis
faail_camel.provenance_class: MORPHOLOGICAL ANALYSIS OUTPUT (not a string test)
faail_camel.confirmation: PROGRAMMATIC WITH SPOT-CHECK. Distinct in kind from the user-confirmed 24-noun / 9-member faaCil contrast of doc 51 SS7, which the user confirmed noun by noun.

disagreement.reading: the shipped surface tag MISSES weak-root realisations of the same morphological class and ADMITS at least one loanword that is not a participle at all. Reported, not repaired -- doc 63 registers BOTH memberships and reads the difference.

faail_surface.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (48 restarts x 500 steps + 6 LS-drop starts); the EXACT R^3 arrangement enumeration is O(n_rows^3) and is INFEASIBLE at this inventory size

saturation_certificate.note: doc 61 SS2.4's certificate fires iff rank(G) == n_rows. At d_joint = 9 the rank is at most 9, so it CANNOT fire at this inventory size and the grade-1 instrument DISCRIMINATES.

grade3.note: grade 3 is TESTABLE at this inventory size because the null is not a point mass (sd > 0) -- the condition doc 61 SS2.5 recorded as failing at exp73's saturated rungs
